what_happened: Dispatch's Gap 3 description (the WSL sync-notice activation entry with the lingering warning) describes packages/sapience-flake/modules/sapience.nix (the non-live fork, added in commit 20715ff), not the live modules/home/services/sapience.nix, which has zero WSL/linger references. 'KEEP the existing activation notice' cannot be executed literally against the live file.

Gap 1's tokenFile already flows through the full sap_token_clean/sap_token_ok/server-verification gauntlet with no code change needed -- just secrets wiring. Gap 2's sourceDirs option description already contains option (b)'s exact required wording ('Run it by hand; nothing here is scheduled and activation never ingests anything'), so the code-side acceptance criterion is already met; only the reasoning record and an (a)-vs-(b) decision remain for planning.

Acceptance Criterion 4 requires verifying 'loginctl show-user <name> --property=Linger' after a nixos-rebuild switch, but a carried memory record in this task's own dispatch states sudo is categorically denied in this harness, so an agent cannot run nixos-rebuild switch to make or verify the linger grant take effect.
